meta.name: pin-setup
meta.description: Use when initializing the pins knowledge graph for the first time in a project. Guides the user through creating pins.yaml (the storage manifest). Triggers on "setup pins", "initialize pins", "create pins.yaml", "first-run pins".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化项目中的 pins 知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中首次启用 pins 知识图谱
copy.tagline_en: Initialize the pins knowledge graph in your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enable pins knowledge graph for the first time in a project

howto.what: Claude 会引导你回答三个问题来创建 pins.yaml 文件：存储位置、数据范围（私有或共享）、是否用 Git 管理。然后写入配置文件并确认路径。如果有旧版 pin 文件，还会执行迁移。
howto.when: 当你首次在项目中使用 pins 知识图谱，说出“setup pins”、“initialize pins”、“create pins.yaml”或“first-run pins”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 pins 知识图谱。
say.note: Claude 会提问并创建配置文件。
Claude 会引导你完成设置。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through answering three questions to create pins.yaml: storage location, scope (private or shared), and git management. Then writes the config file and confirms the path. Optionally migrates legacy pin files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you first use pins knowledge graph in a project and say "setup pins", "initialize pins", "create pins.yaml", or "first-run pins".

say_en.text: Set up the pins knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and create the config.
Claude will walk you through the setup.
